title: Budget consolidation and resource analysis
summary: Conceptual analysis of possible links between employment, public expenditure, municipal revenue and social participation.

text: What links exist between employment, public expenditure, municipal revenue and social participation?

The analysis examines hypothetical links between employment, public expenditure, municipal revenue and social participation. The results are based on explicitly stated assumptions and serve as a conceptual consideration of possible scenarios. They constitute neither an official forecast nor an assessment of any specific public authority.

Based on publicly available statistical data, key figures were compared and hypothetical scenarios developed in order to examine the possible economic and social effects of alternative employment and resource models.
The approach combines quantitative analysis with considerations of the significance of work, financial stability and social participation.
Independent scenario analysis based on publicly available statistical data: selecting and comparing the key figures, formulating the assumptions and developing the scenarios.

status.note: Calculations and assumptions should be read as hypothetical scenarios, not as proven forecasts or realised savings.
